notes.title: KIWF2 Spider Hunt Update and the upcoming 1.0 & Console Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Exterminators (and spiders),

We’re back with another update and this time it’s all about the [b]Spider Hunt mode[/b]! We also want to let you know that this will be the [b]last update before KIWF2 leaves early access with Spider Hell major content update, 1.0 release, and launching on consoles this Summer![/b]

[previewyoutube=cABgCJ7xYps;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Spider Hunt Update Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]New Spider Hunt Maps[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]The House[/b]
The first three levels from KIWF1 return as a single Spider Hunt map!
[*][b]Paper Trail[/b]
Another level returning from KIWF1 for your Spider Hunting pleasure! [/list]
[h3]New Features & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can now customize match settings when creating a Spider Hunt session, including choosing a map, player count, and number of rounds.
[*]Improvements to the “cutout” system while hiding as a spider. [/list]
[h3]Additional Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain consumable weapons would become unavailable after using all ammo for that weapon, even after picking up more ammo of the corresponding type.
[*] Fixed an issue where some settings weren’t saving correctly.
[*] Audio balance changes.
[*] Minor performance improvements.
[/list]
And finally, [b]Kill It With Fire 1 and 2 has a Steam Daily Deal bundle with Spiderheck![/b]
Get all 3 games together for [b]59% off[/b] or individually discounted if you already own one to two.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237756/40d873364aede4de1beb8e2b54ea9f24b61e3af0.png[/img]

notes.title: Cyber Core Update now available!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Exterminators!

Get ready to dive into the [b]Cyber Core Update[/b], the second major content drop in the Kill It With Fire 2 Early Access Roadmap! This update takes you deep into DARWIN’s brain, where you’ll tackle new mini-games, solve puzzles, parkour the platforms, unlock hidden doors, find collectibles, and of course, squash spiders!

[previewyoutube=RaNKZsNFqic;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]New Level: CyberCore[/h3]
[list]
[*] Navigate this arcade-inspired HSF training program to earn your coveted Heavy Armor Clearance.
[/list]
[h3]New Spider: Glitch Spiders[/h3]
[list]
[*] Watch out for these tricky spiders! Each one you kill splits into two spiders that are smaller and faster!
[/list]
[h3]New Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Decompiler: Scrap spiders and objects into bits, to build entirely new objects.
[*] Drone: A reappearance from the first game, but this one has guns and a cute face!
[/list]
[h3]New Lab Project: Butterfly Effect[/h3]
[list]
[*] Collect butterflies (which spawn randomly throughout the game) to unlock the Butterfly Effect.  It shoots spider-seeking butterflies that erase arachnids from existence! Every successful butterfly will duplicate and continue to hunt spiders!  The weapon also slowly regenerates its own ammo.
[/list]
[h3]New Challenge: Drone Race[/h3]
[list]
[*] Test your piloting skills with your new Drone weapon.
[/list]
[h3]New Potion:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [REDACTED] – We’ll let you try and discover this one on your own!
[/list]
[h3]New Blueprint: Jetpack[/h3]
[list]
[*] A flamethrower that takes you to new heights.
[/list]
[h3]New Audio Logs: CyberCore Dev Logs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dive further into the lore by collecting the tape recordings.
[/list]
[h3]New Objectives: x12[/h3]
[list]
[*] Don’t forget to check your clipboard, exterminator.
[/list]
[h3]New Achievements: x10[/h3]
[list]
[*] How many will you get?
[/list]
[h3]New System: Cosmetics![/h3]
[list]
[*] Collect 21 unique cosmetics, including hats, to personalize your exterminator.
[/list]
[h3]A Holiday Surprise![/h3]
[list]
[*] A festive gift awaits—just in time for Christmas!
[/list]

[h2]🎥 Don’t miss the latest Devlog![/h2]

notes.title: KIWF2 Update #2 v0.6.1.5s
notes.notes:
Hey Exterminators!

Update #2 has arrived along with KIWF2's Early Access Roadmap!!

[h3]Save Sync[/h3]
[list]
[*] New feature that allows clients to sync their save file with the host.
[*] This will overwrite your current save slot, so use with caution!
[*] Always starts disabled when you join a co-op session. 
[/list]
[h3]Accessibility[/h3]
[list]
[*] Created a new sub-menu for Accessibility settings.
[*] Moved Arachnophobia settings to this new sub-menu.
[*] Added an option to disable strobe effects (only seen in the vents on the Vindicator)
[/list]
[h3]Early Access Roadmap[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the Early Access Roadmap to the main menu.
[*] The roadmap also automatically pops up when you return to the Vindicator after beating the game.
[*] Some small text changes to make it more clear that Dimension Iota Eight, CyberCore, and Alpha One aren’t available yet.
- Screens on the Vindicator now show Iota Eight and CyberCore as “Coming Soon”
- Screens referring to Alpha One say “Error, Missing Datachip”, then “See Control Room”.  After you complete the game, they switch to “Coming Soon”[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237756/cc755b37e556055aed0cfdcaaa09c7d55de9b227.png[/img]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[h3]Spider Hunt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Exterminators can no longer see spider nameplates.
[*] Spider idle sound spatialization fades away at close distances (only in Spider Hunt)
[*] The Tracker weapon can no longer spawn in Spider Hunt.
[*] Added more weapon spawns to the Vindicator and HEM maps.
[*] Changed the Exterminator vs. Spider ratio on all maps:
  2-4 players: 1 Exterminator
  5-7 players: 2 Exterminators
  8 players: 3 Exterminators [/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Tracker[/h3]
[list]
[*] Vacuumed spiders no longer have tracker blips
[*] The Secret Sniffer now actually works and has an audio cue to go with it.
[*] Unlike the Secret Sniffer Pro, the regular Sniffer upgrade doesn’t take verticality into account; you can use this to your advantage.
[/list]
[h3]Rocket Launcher[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the UI displayed your ammo incorrectly when guiding a rocket.
[*] Fixed a bug where making a sharp turn with a rocket would cause your next rocket to spawn with the same turn speed.
[*] Fixed a bug where standing close to level geometry would sometimes prevent the guided rocket spawning, but still use ammo.
[/list]

[h2]Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added more signage to make it clear where the Reactor is located.
[*] Added more signage to make it clear where Control is located.
[*] Added signage to provide hints on how to reach Control.
[*] Added a few missing localization strings for objectives in Arachnitopia and HEM
[/list]

notes.title: KIWF2 Patch #1 v0.6.21
notes.notes:
Greetings Exterminators,

The very first update is here with some improvements and fixes, thank you all so much for sending us your feedback and reports, please keep them coming!

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] When playing co-op, whenever the host receives an achievement all clients will also receive that achievement.
[*] Cleaning objects with the pressure washer is now considerably faster!
[*] When playing co-op, only the host may start challenges.
[*] Added a message informing players about interactions that only the host can perform (activating portals, buying upgrades, creating blueprints, and starting challenges).
[*] The save slot menu now tracks your progress as a percentage.
[*] Projectiles from player/spider tanks no longer spawn fires.
[*] If you’re playing in an aspect ratio greater than or equal to 2.0 (width/height), the clipboard now only displays four objectives per page.
[*] Explosions now work against swarm spiders and are incredibly effective.
[*] Generally nerfed swarm spiders.
[*] You can no longer vacuum spider eggs.
[*] Potion ingredients are now automatically released when they enter the cauldron.
[*] If you’ve successfully brewed a potion, you cannot cause the cauldron to explode until you take the potion.
[*] Changed the location of the pressure washer to make it much harder to miss.
[*] Added some invisible geometry to help Exterminators climb buildings in Arachnitopia.
[*] Barrels of nuclear waste that are thrown into the ocean will return to their spawn location after a few seconds.
[*] Repositioned the “Rad Cola” recipe to make it easier to read.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could avoid damage during Breaker Challenges by repeatedly entering and exiting the fog.  
[*] Once you’ve been swarmed you can no longer jump.
[*] Changed the models on the salt and pepper to make it more clear which is which.
[*]Added one additional upgrade module to the Vindicator.
[*]Fixed a performance hitch that occurs sometimes on the Vindicator.
[*]Increased the speed of Darwin's text scroll drastically.
[/list]
Also please leave a Steam Review, it would mean the world to us!

[i]- Casey Donnellan & tinyBuild[/i]

notes.title: 95% positive-rated wacky shooter gets a Steam sequel, out right now
notes.notes:
If there's one thing millions of us hate for a reason we can't quite pin down, it's spiders. I'm sure there's something about the way brain signals bounce around my synapses that makes me uncomfortable just looking at them, but I could do with not knowing the specifics, as dealing with surprise spiders in the home is enough. Imagine then, if you will, a game where you take on these arachnid foes as they control the entire space-time continuum. This is Kill It With Fire 2, out today. At least we can bring friends along.

notes.title: Kill It With Fire 2 OUT NOW in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=DlTb97PUaDI;full][/previewyoutube]
The day has come, exterminators.

[h1]Kill It With Fire 2 is out now in Early Access![/h1]

[b]Here’s what you can expect to see on release:[/b]
[list]
[*] Up to 4 player co-op campaign
[*] Up to 8 player Spider Hunt PvP mode with 3 maps
[*] Huge dimensions to explore
[*] Over 10 spider types to exterminate
[*] Tons objectives and challenges to complete, including ones you can die in!
[*] Weapon upgrades to unlock, potions to brew, objects to clean, hidden morph spiders to hunt
[*] And a total of 25 achievements to unlock!
[*] Countless new items to collect, such as: Weapons, Compound X, Tapes (audio logs), Blueprints, SpaceBux, Upgrade Modules.
[/list]
In [b]future updates[/b], you can expect to see 2 more dimensions added - Iota Eight and Alpha One - along with a virtual dimension known as CyberCore.  Each dimension will come with new weapons, spider types, a blueprint, and a potion recipe, along with new objectives, challenges, and other odds and ends!  You can also expect a big boss fight coming at the end of Dimension Alpha One.  Besides that, you can expect another community event (Shoe 2.0), and of course, more spider hunt maps!

We’ll share our roadmap with you soon to keep you posted on everything Casey Donnellan is working on behind the scenes during this early access journey, so keep an eye out for more news soon. And most importantly, these updates will also rely on your feedback! Share your thoughts, suggestions, and bugs in the Steam discussions or on our Discord!

notes.title: 🚨Kill it With Fire 2 has MULTIPLAYER! 🚨 Beta Available NOW
notes.notes:
Grab your Trackers and Hairspray, we are thrilled to confirm that Kill It With Fire 2 will feature multiplayer for the first time ever in human (and arachnid) history! As well as four-player co-op multiplayer for the entire campaign, Kill it With Fire 2 also features the highly tactical, often hilarious, competitive PvP - Spiders versus Exterminators!  

Our PvP Spider Hunt mode is playable NOW by clicking the playtest button on the Steam page! ⬇️ 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2357000/Kill_It_With_Fire_2/]Play Spider Hunt NOW![/url]

Here’s the details you need: 

🕷️Our co-operative mode supports up to FOUR spider-slaying exterminators as you play through the entire campaign from start to finish.

🕷️All players can enjoy the Spider Hunt beta now and play until November 1st 2023, so jump in now and destroy your friends in arachnid form!

🕷️Check out both new modes in our new multiplayer trailer below!

[previewyoutube=cSNr3UJ4zTA;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for your continued support of Kill it With Fire, we are so excited for you to jump into this beta for a sneak peak at what to expect when the full game is released via Steam Early Access in Q1 2024. 

Happy Hunting! 🕸️💖

notes.title: Kill It With Fire 2 adds Red Vs. Blue Writer to the Team
notes.notes:
[b]🚨Attention all spider slayers and interdimensional explorers![/b] Kill It With Fire 2 is now enriched with [i]THREE[/i] times more story content, courtesy of the genius minds of writer Miles Luna and voice talent extraordinaire Andy Cortez! 

[h3]Miles Luna and Andy Cortez Join The Battle![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237756/f4f2c48dba92c44d43a11a01febb528b4084f53b.jpg[/img]
🚀Writer Miles Luna’s previous work includes RWBY, Red vs. Blue, Camp Camp, Slave Zero X. Working with Miles we’ve been able to fully flesh out the Kill It With Fire 2 universe. We’ve taken some of the game’s crazy settings and concepts and woven them together with an interesting backstory populated with an array of hilarious and intriguing characters. 

🌌We also have the highly talented Andy Cortez (Kinda Funny, The Monster Under My Bed) joining the KIWF2 project. Expect highly immersive and occasionally hilarious audio logs throughout your expedition across time and space. 

[h3]Get ready for Kill It With Fire 2’s Early Access, early 2024! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237756/700cdc2f652d2a64788548a9691e7c45c3e7f539.jpg[/img]
🔥When the Steam Early Access debuts in early 2024, players will have access to a vast array of brand-new levels, features, and an arsenal of spider-annihilating weapons. Until then, we will have plenty more surprises and updates to share with you very soon. Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to embrace the madness of Kill It With Fire 2!

🎮 Kill It With Fire 2 launches on PC via Steam Early Access in early 2024. A full release on PC is expected in late 2024.
